# Squaricle Group

> Squaricle Group is made up of several great brands, delivering training that makes truly great people. The Group was founded in 2020 as ted Learning Group and changed its name in June 2021.

Squaricle Group Limited (company number 12647309) is based in London. Registered office: First Floor, 85 Great Portland Street, London, W1W 7LT. Phone: 01732 495925. Email: hello@squariclegroup.com.
Social: [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/10797209/), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/share/19kcQmY4VR/).

The Group's brands are ted Learning, ted HuB, emerging-u, CurioTraining. Each brand's own website is linked below.

## Brands

- [ted Learning (page on this site)](https://www.squariclegroup.com/ted-learning.php): ted Learning: theatre based learning and training using professional actors and expert trainers, founded 2012.
- [emerging-u (page on this site)](https://www.squariclegroup.com/emerging-u.php): emerging-u: leadership, teams and customer experience development; we create the conditions for change.
- [ted Learning (own website)](https://www.tedlearning.co.uk/): ted Learning delivers both classroom-based, virtual and online learning using theatre-based learning, with professional actors and experienced trainers, for any form of training that involves human interaction.
- [ted HuB (own website)](https://hub.tedlearning.co.uk): The ted Learning HuB is a vibrant online learning community where clients' learners access their digital and virtual training, including pre and post-course work, plus free ted Express courses, podcasts, videos and insights.
- [emerging-u (own website)](https://www.emerging-u.com/): emerging-u is a Leadership Learning and Development Agency that specialises in culture change, leadership development and team effectiveness.
- [CurioTraining (own website)](https://www.curiotraining.com/): CurioTraining is an online workplace training brand offering practical, accredited courses for individuals, teams and organisations, with certificates included and easy team enrolment for managers.
